notes: v1.0.17 — Reliable project images. Root cause found: the launcher's security policy blocked in-page fetches to Modrinth's CDN, so covers/icons of mods, resource packs, shaders and datapacks sometimes failed to load with no fallback. Fix: a new main-process image proxy downloads every image with browser headers + retries + a bounded cache, and ModIcon/ProjectImage show a clean placeholder while loading or if an image genuinely can't load — a broken image can never appear again. Gallery screenshots also load lazily (only when you scroll to them).
